points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, metadata, toModel })` is in `model/block/zod.ts`. The flavour is a namespaced string, e.g. `'affine:divider'`. `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (e.g. `'content'`) and the allowed `children`. `props` gives the block's data shape.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>` (`model/block/block-model.ts`), e.g. `DividerBlockModel`.

The view is a Lit custom element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` (`view/element/block-component.ts`). ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal\`tag-name\`)` (`extension/block-view.ts`) maps a flavour to a static-html tag.
Widgets attach to a block through `WidgetViewExtension`.

The store half is a class extending `StoreExtensionProvider` ... Its `setup(context)` calls `context.register(...)` with the schema extension and the adapter extensions. The view half is a class extending `ViewExtensionProvider` ... Other per-block pieces, such as markdown shortcuts and toolbar config, are registered here too.
